arguments.summary: A Cobalt Strike Beacon was detected on host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), attributed to user CORP\jsmith in the Finance department. The initial infection vector was a phishing email triggering an encoded PowerShell script from Outlook, leading to DLL execution via rundll32 from the Temp directory. The malware established C2 communication over HTTPS to 198.51.100.23 and exhibited lateral movement attempts via SMB. The payload performed process injection, created persistence via a scheduled task and registry run key, and activated keylogging capabilities. Multiple alerts were generated but not escalated in time, indicating detection coverage gaps.

timeline.description: User opened Outlook, likely triggering malicious email.
rundll32.exe executed malicious beacon.dll from Temp directory (T1218.011).
IDS alerted on Cobalt Strike C2 beacon to 198.51.100.23 (T1071.001).
Failed Kerberos TGT request indicating potential credential access attempt.
SMB access to file server WS-FIN-050 (T1021.002).
Malware detection alert triggered on svchost_update.dll (hash match).

arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious rundll32 Execution from Temp Directory
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\\rundll32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '%TEMP%'
      - '%LOCALAPPDATA%'
  condition: selection
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1218/011/
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate software updates (rare)
author: SOC Team

title: Encoded PowerShell Launched from Office Application
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
  service: sysmon
  event_id: 1
process:
  - name: powershell.exe
    parent_process:
      - name: outlook.exe
      - name: winword.exe
      - name: excel.exe
  - command_line|contains: '-enc'
  - command_line|contains: '-encodedcommand'
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\\outlook.exe'
      - '\\winword.exe'
      - '\\excel.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-enc'
      - '-encodedcommand'
  condition: selection
level: critical
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001/
falsepositives:
  - Automated Office macros (should be disabled)
author: SOC Team
